items.title: Pilot Study: Preliminary Experience with Dual-strut Tip Support Using Repurposed Cephalic Trim Cartilage in East Asian Rhinoplasty
items.fact_zh: 10例日本女性初鼻，鼻中隔延伸加头侧软骨重制双柱，随诊平均10.1个月，无感染、外露。
items.take_zh: 10例、无对照，原文自称生物力学优势仍是推测；省的是第二块供区，不是手术时间。
items.scene_zh: 鼻中隔不够、又不想多开一个供区的，先把修下来的头侧软骨留着当柱。
items.fact_en: Ten Japanese women undergoing primary rhinoplasty received a trapezoidal septal extension graft plus paired columellar struts made from repurposed cephalic-trim cartilage, with mean follow-up of 10.1 months and no infection, extrusion, septal instability or columellar widening.
items.take_en: With 10 patients, no control group and the authors themselves calling the biomechanical advantage theoretical, this is a way to avoid a second donor site rather than a faster operation.
items.first_affil: From the MSA Surgical Arts, Naha, Okinawa, Japan

items.title: Capsulectomy Following Breast Implant Removal: Evidence-Based Indications and a Framework for Clinical Decision-Making
items.fact_zh: 综述：无研究直接比较切除与保留包膜；9590例预注册队列未见BII症状差异，切除并发症更高。
items.take_zh: 包膜切除只有四个指征：确诊ALCL、包膜恶变、有症状钙化影响钼靶、III–IV级挛缩。其余别当常规。
items.scene_zh: 病人说网上都让全切——先对着有没有那四条指征，没有就照实说切了并发症更多。
items.fact_en: This review finds no study directly comparing explantation with and without capsulectomy; the only pre-registered controlled cohort (n=9590) showed no difference in BII symptom prevalence, and capsulectomy carries more complications.
items.take_en: Capsulectomy is supported by four indications — confirmed BIA-ALCL, capsular malignancy, symptomatic calcification impairing mammography, and grade III-IV contracture — and should not be routine beyond them.
items.first_affil: Specialist Plastic Surgeon, Suite 2, 40 Clyde Road, Berwick, VIC, 3806, Australia

items.title: Interval to Secondary Facelift: A Match-Cohort Analysis of Interval Time, Technique, and Complications
items.fact_zh: 97对97配对：二次拉皮比初次短44.3分钟、更多用SMAS折叠，并发症无差异；间隔平均10.7年。
items.take_zh: 二次拉皮不必当高风险拒掉；初次越年轻间隔越长（r=-0.44）。单术者回顾性，别当承诺。
items.scene_zh: 病人问“十年后再拉一次还行吗”——能拉，风险和第一次差不多，但这是单术者十年的数据。
items.fact_en: In 97 matched pairs, secondary facelifts took 44.3 minutes less than primaries and used SMAS plication more often, with complication rates no different; the mean interval was 10.7 years.
items.take_en: A secondary facelift is not inherently high risk, and younger age at the primary operation predicted a longer interval (r=-0.44), but this is a single-surgeon retrospective cohort and not a promise.

items.title: Predictors and Themes of Perioperative Patient-Initiated Communication in Septorhinoplasty
items.fact_zh: 306例鼻中隔鼻整形，64%在围手术期主动联系医疗组；术前问流程31%、问用药28%。
items.take_zh: 六成人会来问，问的是流程和用药，不是并发症；回顾性单中心，但术前须知该按这两块重写。
items.scene_zh: 病人术后第三天打电话，多半不是出事，是不知道伤口能不能碰、药还吃不吃。
items.fact_en: Among 306 septorhinoplasties, 197 patients (64%) initiated contact with the care team in the 30 days before or after surgery, with procedural details (31%) and medication questions (28%) leading preoperatively.
items.take_en: Most calls are about logistics and medication rather than complications, so the preoperative handout should be rebuilt around those two topics, though this is a single-center retrospective review.
items.first_affil: Department of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery, MedStar Georgetown University Hospital, Washington, District of Columbia, USA

items.title: Stabilizing breast implants with the double anchor capsule flap technique: insights from a retrospective case series of 30 patients
items.fact_zh: 30例双侧翻修用双锚定包膜瓣固定假体，平均减容22.3cc，1年无复发下垂、无错位、无并发症。
items.take_zh: 0并发症的30例单臂系列不能当发生率；值得学的是拿血供包膜当锚，不是那个0。
items.scene_zh: 假体老往下掉、下极越撑越薄的，别急着换大假体，先把包膜留下来当锚。
items.fact_en: In 30 bilateral revision cases using the double-anchor capsule flap technique, implant volume was reduced by a mean of 22.3 cc and there was no recurrent ptosis, malposition or complication at one year.
items.take_en: A single-arm series of 30 with zero complications is not an incidence rate; the transferable idea is anchoring to vascularized capsule, not the zero.
items.first_affil: Interquirofanos, Cl. 7 #39 107 Piso3 y 4, Medellín, Colombia
